description.value: The Highliner Hotel & Conference Centre is a newly renovated 17-storey high-rise occupying a prominent position in downtown Prince Rupert, with 97 guest rooms and sweeping ocean views. It sits minutes from both the BC Ferry and Alaska Ferry terminals, making it a natural staging point for cyclists arriving on or departing to Vancouver Island, Haida Gwaii, or Alaska. An on-site restaurant, First Avenue Bistro, serves the local community as well as hotel guests.

address.value: 815 1st Avenue West, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 1B3
